run_go_env_exports: run env.py with no arguments to print export statements for the Go toolchain environment
run_wrapped_command: run env.py followed by a command to execute it with the hermetic Go environment variables
run_go_version: run env.py go version to check the Go version provided by the hermetic toolchain
run_python_wrapped: run env.py python script.py to execute a Python script with the Go toolchain environment
review_bootstrap_integration: review how env.py loads bootstrap.py via imp.load_source and calls prepare_go_environ and find_executable
